definitions.gloss: sitting with one knee drawn up
definitions.explanation: Sitting on the floor with one knee (or both) raised, foot flat on the floor. A relaxed posture, considered bad manners at a formal meal or in front of superiors.

examples.japanese: {立|た}て{膝|ひざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: To sit with one knee up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}て{膝|ひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行儀|ぎょうぎ}→行儀：02662_gyougi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: It's bad manners to sit with your knee up at meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧とき、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{立|た}て{膝|ひざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When weeding the vegetable patch, my grandmother always worked with one knee up.

notes:
Also written {立膝|たてひざ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立|た}て{膝|ひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sit with a knee up
- {片膝|かたひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to raise one knee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧: formal kneeling, sitting on one's heels — the polite posture
- ⟦あぐら→あぐら：25420_agura⟧: sitting cross-legged — relaxed, traditionally a man's posture
